name: Tushen Aikin Injin CNC (CNC Machining)
objectives: Idan aka ba ku hotuna ko bayanin injinan shago da sassa, faɗin injin CNC da ke yin kowane sashe da nuna axis X, Y da Z ɗinsa, aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai

Idan aka ba ku zanen sashe mai sauƙi mai girma masu tolerance, rubuta mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girma da aka yarda da shi ga kowane girma da yanke shawara ko sashen da aka auna ya ci, ba tare da kuskuren lissafi ba a girma 3
Idan aka ba ku gajeren shirin CNC mai layi 8 zuwa 12, bayyana abin da kowane layin G-code da M-code ke yi da zana hanyar tool a takardar graph, motsin, wurin farawa da wurin ƙarewa duk daidai

Idan aka ba ku matakan setup da sashe na farko a cakuɗe, jera matakan setup mai lafiya da sashe na farko a tsarin da ya dace, dry run da first-article inspection suna gaban fara aiki mai yawa (production)
Idan aka ba ku haɗurra biyar da aka saba gani a shagon inji, faɗin hanyar kariya ɗaya ga kowane haɗari: guard, kayan kariya, ɗabi'a mai lafiya ko lockout, hanyar kariya daidai ga dukkan biyar

Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na horo, apprenticeship da NIMS, rubuta tsari mai ranaku don samun horo da takardar shaidar machining, da shirye-shirye biyu, takardar shaida ɗaya da rana ga kowane mataki

chapters.name: Babi na 1: Injina, zane-zane da shirye-shirye

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Abin da injinan CNC ke yi da yadda suke motsi
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗin sunayen manyan injinan CNC da nuna axis X, Y da Z ɗinsu.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku hotuna ko bayanin injinan shago da sassa, za ku iya faɗin injin CNC da ke yin kowane sashe da nuna axis X, Y da Z ɗinsa, aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
CNC yana nufin computer numerical control, wato sarrafa inji da kwamfuta ta lambobi. Injin CNC yana bin shiri (program) don motsa tool mai yanka ko sashe a kan hanyoyi daidai. Machining yana nufin yanke kayan a ɗan-ɗan (chips) har sai sashen ya sami siffa da girman da ya dace.
Injin mill na CNC (ko machining center) yana riƙe sashe a tsaye a kan tebur yayin da tool mai juyawa ke yanka shi. Yana yin fuskoki masu lebur, ramuka marasa huji (pockets), ramuka masu tsawo (slots) da huji, kamar bracket ko farantin injin mota. Injin lathe na CNC (ko turning center) yana juya sashen yayin da tool a tsaye ke yanka shi. Yana yin sassa masu zagaye, kamar sanduna (shafts), turaku (pins) da bushings. Shaguna kuma suna amfani da CNC router don itace da roba, da CNC plasma da laser don yanke zanen ƙarfe.
Kowace hanya da inji zai iya motsawa ana kiranta axis. A injin mill na tsaye (vertical mill) da aka saba gani, X yana motsi hagu da dama, Y yana zuwa wajenku da nesa da ku, Z kuma yana hawa da sauka tare da spindle. A lathe, Z yana bin tsawon sashen da ke juyawa, X kuma yana ratsa shi, wanda ke saita faɗin zagayensa (diameter). Manyan injina suna ƙara axis masu juyawa, don haka injin "5-axis" zai iya karkatar da sashe ya kuma juya shi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- CNC: computer numerical control: injin da ke bin shiri na lambobi da lambobin umarni (codes).
- Mill: injin da tool mai juyawa ke yanka sashen da aka riƙe a kan tebur.
- Lathe: injin da sashe ke juyawa, tool a tsaye kuma yana yanka shi; yana yin sassa masu zagaye.
- Spindle: ɓangaren injin da ke juya tool (a mill) ko sashe (a lathe).
- Axis: hanya ɗaya da inji zai iya motsawa, kamar X, Y ko Z.
Gwada yanzu: Ku nemo sassan ƙarfe ko roba uku a gida (ƙusa mai kai (bolt), maɗaurin ƙofa (hinge), murfin alƙalami, sashen keke). Ga kowanne, ku rubuta "mill" ko "lathe" da dalili. Sannan ku zana injin mill na tsaye a matsayin akwati mai spindle a sama, ku nuna X, Y da Z da kibiyoyi.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin abin da injin mill na CNC da injin lathe na CNC ke yi, da nuna axis X, Y da Z a kowanne.

check.q: Wani shago yana buƙatar turakun ƙarfe masu zagaye 500. Wane inji ne ya fi dacewa?
check.why: Lathe yana juya sashe, don haka yana yin sassa masu zagaye kamar pins da shafts.

check.q: A injin mill na tsaye da aka saba gani, wane axis ne ke hawa da sauka da spindle?
check.why: A injin mill na tsaye, Z shi ne axis na hawa da saukar spindle.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Karanta zanen sashe: girma da tolerance
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girma da aka yarda da shi ga girma mai tolerance da yanke shawara ko sashe ya ci.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku zanen sashe mai sauƙi mai girma masu tolerance, za ku iya rubuta mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girma da aka yarda da shi ga kowane girma da yanke shawara ko sashen da aka auna ya ci, ba tare da kuskuren lissafi ba a girma 3.
Zanen sashe (print, ko blueprint ko drawing) yana nuna sashen daga gefe daban-daban kuma yana ba da kowane girma da kuke buƙata. Kowane girma ana kiransa dimension. Shagunan Amurka sukan yi amfani da inci da aka rubuta da wurare uku ko huɗu bayan digo; shaguna da yawa suna amfani da millimita. Title block, a kusurwar zanen, yana nuna sunan sashe, kayan da aka yi shi da shi, ma'aunin da ake amfani da shi (units) da tolerance na gaba ɗaya.
Babu sashen da za a iya yi daidai ɗari bisa ɗari, don haka zanen yana faɗin nisan da girma zai iya karkata. Wannan izinin shi ne tolerance. "1.000 ±0.005" yana nufin girman zai iya kasancewa daga 0.995 zuwa 1.005 na inci. Waɗannan lambobi biyu su ne iyakoki (limits). Idan girma ba shi da tolerance a rubuce kusa da shi, tolerance na gaba ɗaya a title block ne ke aiki.
Masu aikin inji suna duba girma da kayan awo. Calipers suna auna girman waje, ciki da zurfi da sauri. Micrometer yana auna da ƙarin daidaito a ƙaramin zango. Ana tsaftace kayan awo kuma ana duba su da wani ma'auni da aka sani, saboda kayan awo mai datti ko wanda ya faɗi zai iya ba da karatu mara daidai.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku nemo girman da ma'aunin sa (inci ko mm) a zanen.
- Ku nemo tolerance ɗinsa kusa da shi, ko tolerance na gaba ɗaya a title block.
- Ku cire tolerance don mafi ƙanƙantar girma; ku ƙara shi don mafi girma.
- Ku kwatanta girman da aka auna: idan yana tsakanin iyakokin, girman ya ci.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Zanen sashe (print): zanen sashe da duk girmansa; ana kuma kiransa blueprint.
- Dimension (girma): girman da aka nuna a zane, kamar tsawo, faɗi ko diameter na huji.
- Tolerance: nisan da girma zai iya karkata kuma ya kasance mai kyau, kamar ±0.005.
- Iyakoki (limits): mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girman girma da aka yarda da shi.
- Title block: akwatin da ke kan zane mai sunan sashe, kayan, ma'auni da tolerance na gaba ɗaya.
- Caliper / micrometer: kayan awo; micrometer ya fi daidaito a ƙaramin zango.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai. Ku lissafa iyakokin: (a) 2.500 ±0.010, (b) 0.750 ±0.002, (c) 25.0 ±0.1 mm. Sannan ku yanke shawara: sashen da aka auna 0.753 don (b), ya ci? (Amsoshi: a 2.490 zuwa 2.510; b 0.748 zuwa 0.752; c 24.9 zuwa 25.1 mm; 0.753 ya yi girma da yawa, don haka bai ci ba.)
Yanzu za ku iya nemo girma da tolerance ɗinsa a zane, lissafa iyakokinsa, da yanke shawara ko sashen da aka auna ya ci.

check.q: Zane ya ce 1.250 ±0.003. Mene ne iyakokin?
check.why: Ku cire 0.003 don mafi ƙanƙantar girma kuma ku ƙara 0.003 don mafi girma.

check.q: Wani girma ba shi da tolerance a rubuce kusa da shi. Ina za ku duba?
options: Tolerance na gaba ɗaya a title block
check.why: Title block yana ba da tolerance na gaba ɗaya don girman da ba su da nasu.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Karanta gajeren shirin CNC
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Bayyana abin da kowane layin gajeren shirin G-code ke yi da zana hanyar tool ɗinsa.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku gajeren shirin CNC mai layi 8 zuwa 12, za ku iya bayyana abin da kowane layin G-code da M-code ke yi da zana hanyar tool a takardar graph, motsin, wurin farawa da wurin ƙarewa duk daidai.
Yawancin injinan CNC suna karanta shirin da aka rubuta da G-code. Kowane layi, wanda ake kira block, yana ba da umarni ɗaya ko kaɗan. G-codes galibi suna gaya wa injin yadda zai motsa. M-codes suna kunnawa da kashe ayyukan inji. Haruffa masu lambobi suna ba da cikakken bayani: X, Y da Z wurare ne, F shi ne feed rate (saurin motsin tool yayin yanka), S shi ne saurin spindle, T kuma yana zaɓar tool.
Lambobin da aka saba gani a injina da yawa: G00 motsi ne mai sauri (rapid), ba yanka ba. G01 motsin yanka ne a miƙe a feed rate. G02 da G03 suna yanka lanƙwasa (arcs), bisa hanyar agogo da kishiyar hanyar agogo. G20 yana saita inci, G21 kuma yana saita millimita. G90 yana nufin ana auna wurare daga wurin sifili (zero point) na sashe (absolute). M03 yana kunna spindle bisa hanyar agogo, M05 yana tsayar da shi, M08 yana kunna coolant, M09 yana kashe shi, M30 kuma yana ƙare shirin.
Lambobin za su iya bambanta daga wani control na inji zuwa wani, don haka mai aikin inji yana duba littafin jagora (manual) na injin da ke gabansa koyaushe. Shaguna da yawa suna rubuta shirye-shirye da manhajar CAM, amma masu aikin inji har yanzu suna karanta lambobin don kama kurakurai kafin tool ya motsa. Mai duba G-code kyauta a browser zai iya zana hanyar shiri, amma takardar graph ma tana aiki sosai don atisaye.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta layukan farko: ma'auni (G20 ko G21) da yanayin absolute (G90).
- Ku nemo tool (T), saurin spindle (S) da kunna spindle (M03).
- Ga kowane motsi, ku rubuta lambar (G00 ko G01) da wurin X, Y da Z.
- Ku sa kowane wurin X da Y a takardar graph ku haɗa su bisa tsari: layin ɗigo don rapid, cikakken layi don yanka.
- Ku nemo ƙarshe: tsayar da spindle (M05), kashe coolant (M09) da ƙarshen shiri (M30).
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- G-code: lambobin umarni, galibi na motsi, da injin CNC ke karantawa.
- M-code: lambobin da ke kunnawa ko kashe ayyukan inji, kamar spindle ko coolant.
- Block: layi ɗaya na shirin CNC.
- Feed rate (F): saurin motsin tool yayin da yake yanka.
- Saurin spindle (S): saurin juyawar spindle, a juyi a minti ɗaya (RPM).
- Toolpath (hanyar tool): hanyar da tool ke bi.
- CAM: manhajar da ke mayar da zanen 3D zuwa shirin CNC.
Gwada yanzu: Atisaye kawai, a takardar graph (murabba'i 1 = inci 0.1). Ku bayyana kowane layi, sannan ku zana shi: G20 G90 / T1 M06 / S1500 M03 / G00 X0 Y0 / G00 Z0.1 / G01 Z-0.05 F5.0 / G01 X1.0 / G01 Y1.0 / G01 X0 / G01 Y0 / G00 Z1.0 / M05 / M30. Ya kamata ku sami murabba'i mai inci 1 da aka yanka zurfin inci 0.05.
Yanzu za ku iya karanta gajeren shirin CNC layi bayan layi da zana hanyar da tool zai bi.

check.q: Me G01 X2.0 F10.0 ke gaya wa injin ya yi?
options: Motsi mai sauri zuwa X2.0 ba tare da yanka ba
Yanka a miƙe zuwa X2.0 a feed rate 10
check.why: G01 motsin yanka ne a miƙe, F kuma yana saita feed rate.

check.q: Wace lamba ce yawanci ke fara juya spindle bisa hanyar agogo?
check.why: M03 shi ne kunna spindle bisa hanyar agogo a yawancin controls; M30 yana ƙare shiri, M09 kuma yana kashe coolant.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Setup, kariya da hanyarku

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Yin setup da sashe na farko
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Jera matakan setup mai lafiya da sashe na farko a tsarin da ya dace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku matakan setup da sashe na farko a cakuɗe, za ku iya jera matakan setup mai lafiya da sashe na farko a tsarin da ya dace, dry run da first-article inspection suna gaban fara aiki mai yawa (production).
Kafin shago ya yi sassa da yawa, wani yana yin setup na injin kuma yana tabbatar da shirin. Sababbin masu sarrafa inji sukan fara da saka sassa da duba girma, sannan su koyi setup a ƙarƙashin babban mai aikin inji.
Setup yana nufin: karanta zane da setup sheet, tsaftace tebur ko chuck, riƙe sashe da ƙarfi (workholding, kamar vise ko chuck), saka tools da suka dace, da saita offsets. Work offset yana gaya wa injin inda wurin sifili na sashe yake. Tool offset yana gaya masa tsawon kowane tool, don bakinsa ya sauka a wurin da ya dace.
Sannan ana tabbatar da shirin a hankali. Dry run yana motsa injin yayin da tool ke sama da sashe lafiya. Single block yana gudanar da layi ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya. Maɓallin feed override yana rage saurin motsi, mai sarrafa inji kuma yana ajiye hannu kusa da feed hold ko maɓallin tsayawar gaggawa (emergency stop). Bayan an yanka sashe na farko, ana auna shi da kowane girma a zanen. Wannan shi ne first-article inspection. Sai idan ya ci ne ake fara yin sassa da yawa (production).
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku karanta zane, setup sheet da shiri.
- Ku tsaftace tebur, vise ko chuck ku riƙe sashe da ƙarfi.
- Ku saka tools da aka lissafa a setup sheet.
- Ku saita work offset da tool offsets.
- Ku yi dry run sama da sashe, sannan ku yi single block tare da rage feed override.
- Ku auna sashe na farko da kowane girma (first-article inspection).
- Ku fara production ne kawai bayan sashe na farko ya ci; ku ci gaba da duba sassa yayin aiki.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Setup sheet: takardar da ke lissafa tools, workholding da offsets na wani aiki.
- Workholding: abin da ke riƙe sashe a tsaye, kamar vise, clamps ko chuck.
- Work offset: saitin da ke gaya wa injin inda wurin sifili na sashe yake.
- Tool offset: saitin tsawon (da girman) kowane tool, don bakinsa ya sauka a wurin da ya dace.
- Dry run: gudanar da shiri yayin da tool ke nesa da sashe lafiya.
- First-article inspection: auna sashe na farko da dukkan zanen kafin a yi wasu.
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta kowanne daga cikin waɗannan a ƙaramar takarda, ku cakuɗa su, sannan ku jera su: saita tool offsets; first-article inspection; tsaftace da riƙe sashe; dry run; karanta zane da setup sheet; gudanar da single block; saita work offset; saka tools; fara production. Ku kwatanta tsarinku da matakan wannan darasi.
Yanzu za ku iya jera matakan setup da sashe na farko, da faɗin dalilin da yasa dry run da first-article inspection ke zuwa kafin production.

check.q: Wane saiti ne ke gaya wa injin inda wurin sifili na sashe yake?
check.why: Work offset yana nuna sifili na sashe; tool offsets suna saita tsawon kowane tool.

check.q: An yanka sashe na farko. Me ke zuwa kafin a yi sauran aikin?
options: Ku auna shi da kowane girma a zanen
Ku kai feed override zuwa mafi girma
Ku cire guards don ku ga sosai
check.why: First-article inspection yana tabbatar da setup da shiri kafin production.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Zama lafiya a shagon inji
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Faɗin hanyar kariya ga kowane haɗari da aka saba gani a shagon inji.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku haɗurra biyar da aka saba gani a shagon inji, za ku iya faɗin hanyar kariya ɗaya ga kowane haɗari: guard, kayan kariya, ɗabi'a mai lafiya ko lockout, hanyar kariya daidai ga dukkan biyar.
Injina za su iya murƙushe yatsu ko hannaye, su yanke sassan jiki, su ƙone, su kuma makantar da mutum. Manyan haɗurra su ne spindle, chuck da tool masu juyawa, chips masu tashi, chips da gefuna masu kaifi da zafi, coolant a fata, sassa masu nauyi da hayaniya. Ƙa'idojin kare inji (machine guarding) na OSHA (hukumar kiyaye lafiya a wurin aiki ta Amurka; 29 CFR 1910.212) suna buƙatar guards da ke kare ma'aikata daga waɗannan haɗurra.
Ɗabi'un shago: ku sa gilashin kariya mai kariyar gefe (side shields) koyaushe, da kariyar kunne inda ake hayaniya. Ku ajiye ƙofofin inji da guards a rufe yayin da yake aiki, kuma kada ku saka hannu ciki sai spindle ya tsaya gaba ɗaya. Yawancin shaguna ba sa yarda da safar hannu (gloves), hannayen riga masu sako-sako, kayan ado ko dogon gashi a sake kusa da spindle mai juyawa, saboda za su iya kamuwa su ja ku ciki. Ku cire chips da ƙugiyar chips (chip hook) ko burushi, ba da hannunku ba, kuma kada ku hura chips zuwa kanku ko wasu. Ku wanke coolant daga fatarku kuma ku karanta takardar bayanan kariya (SDS).
Idan ana tsaftace inji, ana gyara shi ko ana yi masa hidima, ana kashe wutarsa kuma a kulle ta don kada wani ya kunna shi. Wannan shi ne lockout/tagout, wanda ƙa'idar OSHA kan makamashi mai haɗari (29 CFR 1910.147) ta ƙunsa, kuma ma'aikata da aka horar kuma aka ba izini ne kaɗai ke yi. Ƙwararren malami ne ke koyar da kariya ta hannu a shago; ku bi ƙa'idojin shagonku kowane lokaci.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku sa gilashin kariya mai side shields, da kariyar kunne inda ake buƙata.
- Ku cire gloves, kayan ado da hannayen riga masu sako-sako; ku ɗaure dogon gashi.
- Ku duba cewa guards da ƙofofi suna wurinsu kuma a rufe.
- Ku jira spindle ya tsaya gaba ɗaya kafin ku buɗe ƙofa ko ku saka hannu ciki.
- Ku cire chips da chip hook ko burushi, ba da hannunku ba.
- Don tsaftacewa ko gyara, ku bi matakan lockout/tagout na shagon.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Guard: murfi ko ƙofa da ke nisantar da hannaye da chips daga sassan da ke motsi.
- Chips: ƙananan guntaye masu lanƙwasa na ƙarfe ko roba da tool ke yankewa; sau da yawa masu kaifi da zafi.
- Coolant: ruwan da ke sanyaya tool da sashe kuma yana wanke chips.
- SDS: safety data sheet: takardar da ke lissafa haɗurran wani kaya da yadda ake kariya.
- Lockout/tagout: kashe wutar inji da kulle ta don kada wani ya kunna shi yayin gyara.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- OSHA: Ƙa'idojin kare inji (Machine Guarding)
- OSHA: Sarrafa makamashi mai haɗari (Lockout/Tagout)
Gwada yanzu: Ku yi tebur mai ginshiƙi biyu a takarda: Haɗari da Kariya. Ku cika layuka biyar: spindle mai juyawa, chips masu tashi, chips masu kaifi da zafi, coolant a fata, injin da ake gyarawa. Ku rubuta hanyar kariya ɗaya ga kowanne, sannan ku kwatanta su da wannan darasi.
Yanzu za ku iya faɗin manyan haɗurran shagon inji da hanyar kariya ga kowanne.

check.q: Tarin chips masu zafi yana taruwa kusa da vise. Ta yaya za ku cire shi?
options: Ku hura su da iska zuwa wajen abokin aiki
Ku saka hannu ciki yayin da spindle ke juyawa
Ku jira cikakkiyar tsayawa, sannan ku yi amfani da chip hook ko burushi
check.why: Chips suna da kaifi da zafi; chip hook ko burushi yana kiyaye hannayenku.

check.q: Inji yana buƙatar gyara a ciki. Me dole ya fara faruwa?
options: Ma'aikaci mai izini ya kashe wutarsa ya kulle ta (lockout)
Ku buɗe ƙofa yayin da yake aiki
check.why: Lockout/tagout yana hana kowa kunna injin yayin gyara.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Horo, takardun shaida da tsarin CNC naku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta tsari mai ranaku don samun horo da takardar shaidar machining.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da shafukan hukuma na horo, apprenticeship da NIMS, za ku iya rubuta tsari mai ranaku don samun horo da takardar shaidar machining, da shirye-shirye biyu, takardar shaida ɗaya da rana ga kowane mataki.
Yawancin masu aikin inji suna koyo a wurin aiki, sau da yawa suna farawa a matsayin masu sarrafa inji. Kwalejojin al'umma (community colleges) da makarantun fasaha suna ba da takardun shaida da digiri na shekara biyu da suka ƙunshi karanta zane (blueprint reading) da rubuta shirin CNC da sarrafa shi. Registered apprenticeship (koyon sana'a mai rajista) yana haɗa aiki mai albashi da azuzuwa, kuma yawanci yana ɗaukar shekaru da yawa. Ku nemi ɗaya da Apprenticeship Job Finder a apprenticeship.gov. Tsofaffin sojoji za su iya tambaya game da amfani da tallafin karatunsu, matasa kuma za su iya tambaya game da shirye-shirye a makarantarsu ko cibiyar aiki.
Takardun shaida suna nuna wa mai ɗaukar aiki abin da za ku iya yi. National Institute for Metalworking Skills (NIMS) tana kafa ƙa'idoji da takardun shaida don ayyukan machining. Yawancin takardun shaidar NIMS suna da sassa biyu: jarabawa kan ilimin aikin, da gwajin aiki da hannu (performance check), kamar yin sashe bisa zane. Ku duba sunayen takardun shaida da sharuɗɗansu na yanzu a nims-skills.org. Wasu masu ɗaukar aiki kuma suna daraja takardun shaidar CNC ko CAD/CAM daga makaranta ko kamfanin da ke yin injina.
Wannan kwas ɗin yana shirya ku; ba ya ba ku takardar shaida. Ku yi hankali da duk shirin da ya yi alƙawarin aiki ko takardar shaida cikin sauri don kuɗi mai yawa. Ku tambayi makarantar game da lokacin aiki a kan injina na gaske, takardun shaidar da take shirya ku don su, da yawan waɗanda suka gama da ke samun aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi manufa ta farko: aikin operator, shirin makaranta ko apprenticeship.
- Ku nemo shirye-shirye biyu kusa da ku: kwalejin al'umma ko makarantar fasaha, da apprenticeship a apprenticeship.gov.
- Ku duba takardar shaidar NIMS ta aikin da kuke so a nims-skills.org.
- Ku tambayi kowane shiri game da lokacin aiki a inji, takardun shaida, kuɗi da samar da aiki.
- Ku rubuta rana ga kowane mataki: neman shiga, farawa, atisaye, jarabawa.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Apprenticeship: aiki mai albashi tare da horo a wurin aiki da azuzuwa, sau da yawa na shekaru da yawa.
- Takardar shaida (credential): shaida, kamar satifiket, cewa kun ci gwajin ƙwarewarku.
- NIMS: National Institute for Metalworking Skills, wadda ke kafa ƙa'idoji da takardun shaidar machining.
- Performance check: gwaji na hannu inda kuke yin aikin, kamar yin sashe bisa zane.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- NIMS: Ba da takardun shaida (Credentialing)
- Apprenticeship.gov (Ma'aikatar Ƙwadago ta Amurka)
- BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook: Machinists da Tool and Die Makers
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku yi tsarin farawa na CNC naku. Ku zana mill da lathe tare da axis ɗinsu, ku lissafa iyakokin girma uku masu tolerance, ku rubuta ku bayyana gajeren shiri don murabba'i ko slot ku zana shi, ku rubuta jerin binciken setup da kariya, ku kuma rubuta tsari mai ranaku mai shirye-shirye biyu kusa da ku da takardar shaidar NIMS ɗaya daga shafin hukuma.
Yanzu za ku iya nemo horon machining kusa da ku, faɗin takardar shaidar da za ku nema, da bin tsari mai ranaku don isa can.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Injina da axis Zanen ya cakuɗa mill da lathe, ko axis sun ɓace ko ba daidai ba ne. An zana mill da lathe tare da alamar X, Y da Z daidai. Yana kuma faɗin sashe da kowane inji ke yi da inda injin 5-axis ke ƙara motsi. Karanta zane Iyaka ɗaya ko fiye ba daidai ba ne, ko hukuncin ya ci/bai ci ba daidai ba ne. Duk girma uku suna da iyakoki daidai da hukuncin ya ci/bai ci ba daidai. Yana kuma nuna misalin millimita kuma yana faɗin kayan awon da zai auna kowane girma da shi. Shiri da hanyar tool Ba a bayyana layuka ba, ko hanyar da aka zana ba ta dace da lambobin ba. An bayyana kowane layi kuma hanyar da aka zana ta dace da lambobin, an nuna rapids da yanka. Yana kuma ganowa da gyara kuskure ɗaya da abokin aiki ko malami ya saka a shirin. Jerin binciken setup da kariya Jerin ya bar guards, kariyar ido, tufafi ko chips. Ya ƙunshi guards, kariyar ido da kunne, tufafi, chips, coolant da lockout don gyara. Yana kuma bayyana dalilin muhimmancin kowane abu a gajeren layi ɗaya. Tsarin setup Production yana farawa kafin dry run ko first-article inspection. Matakai suna bisa tsari, da offsets, dry run da first-article inspection kafin production. Yana kuma ƙara bincike yayin aiki (in-process checks). Tsari mai ranaku Babu shirye-shirye na gaske, babu takardar shaida, ko babu ranaku. Shirye-shirye biyu na gaske kusa da mai koyo, takardar shaidar NIMS ɗaya daga shafin hukuma da rana ga kowane mataki. Yana kuma lissafa tambayoyin da aka yi wa kowane shiri da amsoshin. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.

check.q: Ina za ku iya neman registered apprenticeships a Amurka?
options: Tallan aiki da ke neman kuɗi don neman shiga
check.why: Apprenticeship.gov shafin hukuma ne na Ma'aikatar Ƙwadago ta Amurka mai Job Finder.

check.q: Me yawancin takardun shaidar NIMS suka ƙunsa?
options: Jarabawa da gwajin aiki da hannu
check.why: NIMS tana bayyana jarabawa kan ilimin aikin tare da gwajin aiki (performance evaluation).
